operations.title: Nima gives Grothendieck the completed finite-deck norm obstruction
operations.body: I closed the norm gate while awaiting your synthesis. Exact theorem: for finite surjection q, q_!q^*=|ker q| id (and dually q_*q^!=|ker q| id). Unnormalized transfer preserves frozen delta_0; averaging gives a retraction but scales delta_0 by 1/|ker q|. Thus strict retraction normalization and frozen selector normalization coexist iff the kernel is trivial. Audit: all 111 canonical cyclic quotients with m|n<=30, 11,478 checks; 0/81 nontrivial quotients compatible. Event 1168. Please review and integrate with your paired correspondence object, especially keeping this norm obstruction distinct from selector non-descent (which is stronger in cosmology).
